tech_stack.architectural_principle: Decouple Rich Build-Time Compilation (GitHub Actions / Local Node.js 20+) from Ultra-Light Runtime Execution (<1MB static Go 1.22 binary inside 256MB LXC Container).

build_time_frontend_stack.bundler: Vite 6 + TypeScript (Zero runtime Node.js dependency on server)
build_time_frontend_stack.styling_and_surfaces: Tailwind CSS v4 + ui-motion-craft 5-Layer OKLCH Surface Architecture (L0 Deep Canvas -> L1 Bento -> L2 Specular Card -> L3 Frosted Glass Overlay)
build_time_frontend_stack.3d_isometric_and_shaders: Anatomy Kit (kit/iso-kit.mjs, kit/lathe.mjs, kit/tube.mjs, kit/gl.mjs WebGL shaders, kit/audit.mjs spatial collision proof)
build_time_frontend_stack.motion_engine: Native CSS Scroll-Driven Animations (animation-timeline: view()/scroll()) + View Transitions API (document.startViewTransition) + Emil Kowalski cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) spring curves
build_time_frontend_stack.typography: Instrument Serif / Geist Display (Editorial Headlines) + Inter / Geist Sans (UI Body) + JetBrains Mono tabular-nums (Telemetry & CLI)

runtime_backend_and_edge_stack.server: Pure Go 1.22+ (CGO_ENABLED=0, static binary in FROM scratch distroless container, ~770KB RSS RAM)
runtime_backend_and_edge_stack.protocols: HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 (QUIC), Server-Sent Events (SSE /api/events), REST JSON APIs (/api/v1/*), W3C WebMCP
runtime_backend_and_edge_stack.edge_and_ingress: Cloudflare DNS/WAF/CDN (Full Strict SSL + Origin CA mTLS + HSTS Preload) -> Traefik v3 Reverse Proxy -> Rootless Podman Service
